in_sanskrit.name: Roky
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Rock, Mountain
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Roky एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Roky is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Rukh' which means 'Rock' or 'Mountain'. This name is often given to babies born in mountainous regions or to those who are believed to have a strong and stable character.
